main:
Existing Patients Follow-ups

Welcome back to The Schoeman Clinic.

It is lovely to have you with us again. To arrange your follow up, choose the consultation you need, select your doctor, and pick a day and time to suit you.

Where possible, you are warmly encouraged to book with the doctor you have seen before. If they are not available when you need them, any of our doctors can help, each working to the same four-pillar methodology, so your care continues seamlessly from one appointment to the next.

Once your appointment is confirmed, we will send you everything you need beforehand. If there is anything in particular you would like to focus on this time, do let us know ahead of your visit.

We look forward to seeing you again.

Book your follow-up appointment

Continue to our secure Semble booking portal to choose the consultation, doctor and time that suit you.

02 Select your doctor
03 Pick a date and time
